description: This file defines a generic class 'ConcurrentLoadGenerator<TState>' in the namespace 'Benchmarks.Ping'. The class provides functionality to perform concurrent load testing by issuing requests in parallel using multiple worker tasks, collecting timing and success/failure metrics, and reporting throughput and failure rates.

classes.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1
classes.description: A class for generating load with concurrent requests, measuring success, failure, and throughput metrics.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the load generator with concurrency settings, request functions, and logging options.

methods.name: Warmup
methods.description: Performs warmup by running worker tasks without including warmup blocks in reports.

methods.name: ResetBetweenRuns
methods.description: Resets the internal channel for completed work blocks.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the load test by initializing worker tasks, collecting and optionally logging intermediate results, then reporting final metrics.

methods.name: PrintReport
methods.description: Generates a summary report of request throughput, total requests, and failures over the collected blocks.

methods.name: RunWorker
methods.description: Executes a worker loop that issues requests repeatedly until the specified number of blocks is completed, recording timing and success/failure counts.
